scope: Read-only source, result and archive audit plus two read-only status calls; no process launch, admission, tick, tamper mutation or rerun of 16-command probe. Only this new review file written.

findings.assessment: historyScans counts entries generator invocations, not entries yielded or total history I/O. pinCalls counts in-process execution.pin invocations, including calls via verify_pin; execution.checked independently hashes bytes and is not counted. Child-process pin calls are outside this instrumentation. Counts are valid as labeled, not total hashing/system-operation counts.

probe.py appends one whitespace byte only to cycle-0 plan, calls tick, asserts some admission quarantine plus incomplete status, and restores bytes in finally. Current cycle-0 bytes authenticate against original admission and all 16 clean outcomes independently verify. The transient bad status is not persisted; retrospective review cannot independently replay its exact quarantine queue/error without mutation. The asserted historical gate is supported by source and run result, not a separately preserved tamper receipt.

Recorded counts grow linearly per operation; enqueue performs one complete history scan plus J-by-H ownership search. Serial N one-job admissions therefore accumulate quadratic history work. Each normal tick scans entries twice; repeated verified_result paths rehash completed artifacts. Existing findings appropriately restrict measurements to 160 pending plans and 16 serial synthetic executions. No proof of thousand-cycle durability, science throughput or automatic adaptive planning.

probe.py creates fixed fixture directories with mkdir and does not support rerunning in place; preserving fixtures is intentional but reproducing requires a fresh copied package/path. Its 45-second deadline is checked only in the reconciliation loop, after dispatch calls, and is not a hard interrupt for blocking queue operations. The preceding 160 admissions are outside the deadline. Findings call this an incremental-loop deadline, which is consistent with this scope.

All 694 archived members match manifest and current fixture bytes exactly. Embedded absolute paths and source pins make archive evidence capture rather than a portable executable store restore, as its manifest already discloses.

recommendedNextStep: Keep these measured formulas and the immediate historical-tamper detection contract explicit when reviewing an opt-in incremental design. Do not equate pinCalls with total hashing work; separately count checked calls/bytes if later benchmarking is needed.
